def test_invalidate_prefix_removes_matching_string_keys():
    c = LRUCache(4)
    c.set("api/users", 1)
    c.set("api/admin", 2)
    c.set("db/users", 3)
    c.set("api", 4)
    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("api")
    assert removed == 3
    assert list(c.items) == ["db/users"]


def test_invalidate_prefix_leaves_non_string_keys_untouched():
    c = LRUCache(4)
    c.set("api/users", 1)
    c.set(("api", "users"), 2)
    c.set("api/admin", 3)
    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("api")
    assert removed == 2
    assert list(c.items) == [("api", "users")]
